title: Cache Updates
description: Learn how to update the cache after mutations.

data.text: After a mutation, you often need to update the cache to reflect the changes. Apollo provides several ways to do this.

data.title: update
cache.modify
cache.evict
data.text: Use cache.evict() to remove items from cache. Use cache.gc() to garbage collect orphaned objects.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: update function modifies cache after mutation
data.takeaway: Cache updates keep UI in sync with server.
